name: opamp-circuit-designer
description: Op-amp circuit designer: amplifiers, Sallen-Key/MFB filters and Schmitt triggers with E-series parts, schematic and GBW-aware frequency response. Runs in the browser.

paragraphs: Pick an op-amp circuit, type the gain, cutoff or threshold you want, and get standard E-series resistor and capacitor values, a schematic, a results table and a frequency response that includes your op-amp's gain-bandwidth limit. Everything runs in your browser.
features: Eleven circuits. Inverting, non-inverting, difference, instrumentation (three op-amps) and summing amplifiers, an integrator with a DC-gain limit, Sallen-Key low-pass and high-pass, multiple-feedback (Rauch) low-pass…

Real parts. Resistors from E6 to E192 and capacitors from E6 to E192. For gain-setting pairs and capacitor ratios it searches for the combination with the smallest error, not just the nearest value of each.

GBW-aware response. Magnitude and phase plots show the chosen op-amp (finite gain and gain-bandwidth) against an ideal one, with the -3 dB point marked. Presets for common op-amps (LM358, TL072, NE5532, OPA1612 and…

Honest numbers. Results show the achieved gain, f0 and Q against the target, the worst-case gain error for your resistor tolerance, closed-loop bandwidth, CMRR from resistor tolerance, Schmitt thresholds and more, with…
Schematic drawn as SVG for every circuit, with the standard values on it, and a copyable parts list.
